decisions.rationale: Converge by making the claim rule match what is delivered, not by adding more machinery. A fragment is CLAIMED only if it has a named pre-application check inside the increment and a named public test that observes it. Every other fragment the project uses is listed as 'practised, not claimed', and owned by its topic page and quiz. Apply this row by row (Collections, Module/script, Stream, FT11), keeping the frozen calendar, syllabus and 70-minute increments unchanged. No new checks are required; add one only where it fits the existing check minutes.

Mark loading-into-a-staging-table-with-upserts#o2 as partial, '[keying the conflict target on a unique constraint]' not claimed, or add a minuted teach-check step for it if it fits. Apply the same claimed/practised rule as above.
